# Commands console and shared Thunderbird memory system

Core implementation remains `commands/knowledge/{store,sync,learning,service,embeddings,import}.mjs`. Retrieval combines SQLite FTS with optional local MiniLM vectors and defaults `maxContextChars` to 10,000. Focused validation recorded 137 console/knowledge tests, 19 earlier package tests, and an isolated app-server smoke test for native-memory exclusion. [Task 1]

Scope: general.
